description: This file defines the SystemNotification entity class, which models system notifications within the application. It includes fields for notification key, value, associated merchant store and user, start and end dates, and audit information. It is mapped to a database table 'SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION' with JPA annotations.

classes.name: SystemNotification
classes.description: Entity class representing system notifications, mapped to the SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION table. Includes notification key, value, associated merchant store and user, date range, and audit information.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section information for this entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section information for this entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the configuration key of the notification.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the configuration key of the notification.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value/content of the notification.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value/content of the notification.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates the notification with a merchant store.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the notification.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates the notification with a user.
